ways.label: Tiki Trail to Ben Lomond Summit

start.name: Skyline Gondola base
start.quote: Skyline Gondola base on Brecon street

evidence: This track starts from the Skyline Gondola base on Brecon street.
Climb to the 1,326 m Ben Lomond Saddle.
The hardest part of the climb remains as you approach Ben Lomond's 1,748 m summit.

ways.label: Tiki Trail to Ben Lomond Saddle

start.name: Tiki Trail
start.quote: You can follow the Tiki Trail

evidence: You can follow the Tiki Trail to hike to Ben Lomond Saddle from Queenstown.

ways.label: Skyline Gondola top complex to Ben Lomond Saddle
evidence: Enjoy a shorter tramp on the Ben Lomond Track by riding the Gondola to the Skyline complex and hiking to the Ben Lomond Saddle and back.

doubts: Ben Lomond Station is private land the track crosses beyond the saddle, not a stop. The access points do not say where they join the Ben Lomond Track.
